Case: Patient D is a 38-year-old Hispanic man with a known cervical chordoma status-post multiple resections presenting with 2 months of progressive neck pain accompanied with thoracic and abdominal pain. Acetaminophen and ibuprofen provide no relief, and he is now unable to sleep. On physical exam, you note dysesthesia to palpation of his neck and pain to deep palpation of his abdomen.
